events.note: GRO online index, Births Mar Q 1907, Whitehaven 10b/689 — looked up by the tree owner 2026-07-03. A maiden name in the column (not 'Larkin') means the birth was registered as legitimate: she was recorded as Thomas Larkin's wife.

notes: MANUALLY CREATED RECORD (M-prefix: not from the GEDCOM; parser re-runs never touch it). Ellen M Larkin's mother, identified 2026-07-03 by the tree owner's GRO index lookup: maiden name McALONE. Forename unknown. Irish surname, fitting Whitehaven's Irish Catholic community.

OPEN: her forename and fate. Was she also Samuel Larkin's mother (GRO lookup: Births Jun Q 1903, Whitehaven 10b/733 — matching maiden name would confirm)? Is she the 'Mary Ellen Larkin, 42' who died Mar Q 1906 Whitehaven (10b/429)? If so, Ellen's Nov 1906 birth is impossible for her and the registration's married-name presentation needs explaining; if not, she likely survived — but she is absent from the family's 1918-1921 US movements (Ellen crossed alone in 1921 after her father's death), so she probably died 1911-1921 in England. No Thomas Larkin x McAlone marriage is registered in Cumberland 1880-1911; the marriage was likely in Ireland, Scotland, or pre-1892 Maine.
